//: West TN TWRA winter put-and-take trout waters (BACKEND-ISSUES: West TN blank map). First-party curated anchor points for catalog streams that have NO NHD/TIGER linear geometry — they are small impoundments and park ponds, not mapped flowlines. Coordinates: 'osm-nominatim' anchors were resolved against OpenStreetMap (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL) in 2026-09 and land inside the named park/lake; 'approx-town-anchor' anchors sit at the named town because OSM has no park polygon yet — the UI must render them as approximate. Stocking names are verbatim TWRA published-schedule rows (sourceUrl on each stream), which is what matchStocking resolves against.

features.name: Shelby Farms
features.note: TWRA winter put-and-take lake in Shelby Farms Park, Memphis. Rainbow trout in the cold months only — they do not hold over summer.
